column5: text
Imagine your alarm rings, and it has been raining for three days.
Not one second of sun.
Today the water pushed past your front door.
You block it with stacked towels.
Outside, your street has become a little sea.
Our blue car floats like an island.
Ducks moved in for free.
They swim where the road was.
Upstairs the water follows.
On day four, your family sleeps on the kitchen table.
So you wait on the flat roof with the whole street.
Waiting for the rain to take one breath.
From up here you can see where the rain ends.
A perfect circle.
Outside it, the sun still shines.
Yesterday, that circle was exactly your city.
Today it is one street wider.
The rain is growing.
One street wider, every single day.
Where does it stop?
